summary: Reworked the backend from the obsolete Section↔Group N:N implementation to the approved 1:N sections.group_id contract. Removed section_groups and its endpoints/payloads, updated migrations and authorization queries, preserved grant-0/default-Section rules and manager metadata oversight, and added group member listing.

Residual scans found no runtime section_groups, group_ids, connectGroup, disconnectGroup, or required_grade references.
Database integration testing was not run because no approved disposable PostgreSQL instance was provided; npm test remains the documented failing placeholder.
